correctness.rationale: An exact one-step conditioning argument gives E Δ=2E/n+r, E Δ²=[2S+(2+4r)E]/n+r and E ΔS=[3S+(2+4r)E]/n. Their closed moment recurrences solve to E E_n=rn(n−1)/2 and Var E_n=r(1−r)n(n−1)(n²+n+3)/18. The bounded centered process (E_n−E E_n)/[n(n+1)] is a martingale; martingale convergence plus F_n=r+2(n+1)M_n/(n−1) proves almost-sure and L² convergence. The variance tends to 2r(1−r)/9, strictly positive for interior r. The packaged script passed 1,940 exact finite assertions, which supplement rather than replace the analytic proof.
